business_control_distribution.interpretation: Sampled request occupancy, not GPU utilization or a counterfactual capacity proof.

limitations: Single known-workload development observations, not causal graph-only effects.
Matching rolling P95 to a recorded request does not reconstruct unrecorded sample arrival order.
Startup wait remains user-visible TTFT and cannot be subtracted or excluded from control.
Stage grouping is descriptive; runtime-slot envelope includes owner confirmation, not only empty-slot waiting.
No hypothetical saved GPU time, counterfactual latency, or numeric correctness qualification.
